title: Critical quasi-linear Schrödinger system with $p$-Laplacian
summary: In this paper, we mainly consider positive solution to the $D^{1,p}(\R^{N})$-critical quasi-linear Schrödinger system with $p$-Laplacian: \begin{equation*}\begin{cases} -Δ_p u = u^αv^β \, \ \ \ \ \ \text{in}\,\ \ \R^N, \\ -Δ_p v = u^βv^α \,\ \ \ \ \ \text{in}\,\ \ \R^N, \end{cases}\end{equation*} where $1<p<N$, $N\geq2$, $0\leq α\leq β,$ and $u,v\in D^{1,p}(\R^N)$. We establish regularity and the sharp estimates on asymptotic behaviors for any positive solution $(u,v)$.
